notes: Batch Split Wraps for The Library. Adds BATCH SPLIT WRAPS to the Split tab. Select multiple full-wrap cover images in one session, then edit each cover independently with its own left and right spine edges. Guides can be adjusted by dragging them over the preview or by entering pixel values. Each cover keeps its own guide positions while moving through Previous/Next or the queue. Covers can be marked ready individually, skipped/unskipped, or removed from the queue. SAVE ALL READY exports Back.png, Spine.png, and Front.png into a separate folder for each finished cover. There is intentionally no Apply to All control. Existing Library data is not replaced. Windows PowerShell parsing, synthetic patching, payload validation, and all internal SHA-256 checks passed before publish.
